desc:
📌 QoL UPDATES: Experience completely redesigned interfaces, an upgraded MDT and radio system, new criminal equipment, improved law enforcement features, and much more!

🌲 Welcome to Berkeley County!

Located in eastern Concord, this busy county is home to a lot of action! 

Play as a Police Officer and keep the streets safe. Extinguish fires as a Firefighter and help injured players as a Paramedic. Organize emergency services as a Dispatcher. Maintain the roads as Public Works (DOT). As a Civilian, play as a mail carrier, sanitation worker, or cause mischief as a criminal!

💰 Receive a $10K bonus by joining the Five-O Community Roblox group!
